zh.body:
我應徵貴公司前端工程師職缺，是因為長期關注貴团队在 React 與 Next.js 產品上的技術深度，以及重視使用者體驗與跨職能協作的文化。過去三年我主導多個 B2B SaaS 介面重構，從需求釐清、設計對接到上線監控皆有完整經驗，與本職缺強調的端到端交付高度吻合。

我具備履歷與職缺共同要求的 React、TypeScript、Next.js 與 REST API 整合能力；在現職曾以 React Query 優化資料快取策略，將核心頁面載入時間降低約三成，並建立可重用的元件庫提升團隊交付效率。我也熟悉遠端協作與英文技術文件閱讀，能快速融入分散式團隊節奏。

若貴團隊需要能同時理解產品目標與工程實作的前端工程師，我能以實際專案成果與持續學習態度貢獻價值。期待有機會進一步說明我如何協助貴公司推進產品目標。

en.body:
I am applying for the Frontend Engineer role because your team’s focus on React and Next.js product delivery, combined with a strong emphasis on user experience and cross-functional collaboration, aligns closely with how I have grown my career over the past three years. I have led end-to-end delivery on multiple B2B SaaS interface rebuilds—from discovery and design handoff through launch and monitoring—which maps directly to the ownership this role expects.

My background matches your core stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, and REST API integration. In my current role I introduced React Query caching patterns that cut key page load times by roughly thirty percent and built a shared component library that improved team throughput. I am comfortable working remotely and reading technical documentation in English, so I can integrate quickly into a distributed team.

If you need a frontend engineer who connects product goals with solid implementation, I would welcome the chance to discuss how my project outcomes and learning mindset can support your roadmap.

熟悉遠端協作與跨職能溝通（設計、後端、產品）
具元件庫與可維護架構實務，能提升團隊交付效率
